tableLines.line: The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Vivian speaks at Thornfield's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Vivian speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

FUSION REACTOR: the pellet goes in — properly, inside you. A warm hum starts behind your ribs and settles. You will never be hungry again. One reactor per world: yours. It does not come out. (The System is DELIGHTED. That should worry you.)

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.

The little star inside Dieter goes quiet — and wakes up inside Inas. Dieter never got hungry while the village did, so the pellet moved to hungrier hands: Inas will never be hungry again while it hums, and Dieter is hungry again, for the first time in a long while. The table can hear a feast again.
With Haven grieving, Thornfield installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 6,000 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.

With Haven grieving, Emberhold installs their own speaker at the table — but the bond is young, and they're still deciding what Haven is. The new speaker wants to talk before the tribute changes. Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.
💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Kenji.

Seven days of silence, and the silence answered for Haven. Emberhold's new speaker reads it plainly. (Trust -6.) Emberhold installs their own speaker at the table after all — tribute rises to 6,000 kcal/week. Grief became leverage, and they knew it would.
